title: Notification regarding Hon'ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma will hold single Bench at 2:00 p.m. today i.e. 07th July 2025.
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 07th July, 2025
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ : it is informed to all learned members of the Bar
and litigants that Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma will hold Single Bench today
07th July, 2025 at 2:00 p.m. instead of 10:30 a.m.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(KH. A]IT SINGH)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt. No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ / 2+2/ T3 q Imphal, the 07th July, 2025
